description: Soy una participante de Panamá apasionada por la exploración espacial, la defensa planetaria y la educación científica para jóvenes. Creé PIDO (Project Interplanetary Defense Octagon), un proyecto que combina ingeniería orbital inspirada en la histórica misión LDEF de la NASA con herramientas educativas creativas para acercar la ciencia del espacio a las nuevas generaciones.
summary: PIDO (Project Interplanetary Defense Octagon) is a constellation of 8 solar-powered, self-healing satellites in polar orbit designed to protect Earth from space debris and hazardous asteroids while inspiring young learners. Inspired by NASA’s historic Long Duration Exposure Facility (LDEF)—which orbited Earth for nearly six years and was successfully retrieved—PIDO ensures no orbital hazard is "abandoned and forgotten." The fleet combines 2 Watchmen satellites for tracking, 3 Laser Ablation units to gently deflect asteroids without fragmenting them, and 3 Robotic Collectors that retrieve space debris to prevent Kessler Syndrome and create a circular space economy. Alongside the engineering concept, PIDO includes educational tools, such as space-themed word searches, to teach future generations about planetary defense.
details:
PIDO (Project Interplanetary Defense Octagon) is a polar-orbit satellite constellation and educational outreach project designed to protect Earth from orbital debris and hazardous asteroids while inspiring young students to explore space science and history.

1. Historical Inspiration: The Legacy of LDEF Inspired by NASA’s Long Duration Exposure Facility (LDEF)—which orbited Earth for nearly six years before being successfully retrieved by Space Shuttle Columbia in 1990—PIDO proves that spacecraft and orbital hardware should never be "abandoned and forgotten." Just as LDEF’s micrometeoroid "scars" taught scientists how to protect future missions on the Moon, Mars, and beyond, PIDO applies those historical lessons to actively monitor, recover, and safeguard Earth’s orbital environment.

2. How It Works: The 8-Satellite Polar Constellation Operating in polar orbit for complete planetary coverage, PIDO consists of 8 solar-powered satellites equipped with self-healing software capable of detecting internal faults and repairing bugs via over-the-air updates:

• 2 Watchmen Satellites: Continuously scan, track, and triangulate hazardous asteroids and space debris to prevent gaps in orbital defense.

• 3 Debris-Collecting Satellites: Equipped with approach radars and mechanical arms with advanced robotic grippers to capture space junk, mitigating the threat of Kessler Syndrome. Recovered artifacts are safely returned to Earth for scientific study and museum auctions, creating a circular space economy that helps self-fund the fleet.

• 3 Laser Ablation Units: Use precise thermal energy pulses to gently alter the trajectory of approaching asteroids without fragmenting them into smaller, unpredictable hazards.

3. Creativity, Impact & Youth Education PIDO was born from a personal desire to transform fear of cosmic hazards into scientific curiosity for future generations. Alongside the engineering architecture and hand-drawn satellite schematics created using digital design tools, PIDO includes an educational word search puzzle designed for young learners, featuring key terms like LDEF, Orbit, Debris, Scars, Octagon, and Pioneer to make planetary defense and space history fun and accessible.
